title: registry/<owner>__<repo>.yaml
description: A pointer to an app repository. Everything else comes from the app's own labconstrictor-app.yaml and its latest release.

repo_id.description: Numeric GitHub id; survives renames, so a changed owner can be noticed.

section.description: Set to testing for apps that check or maintain LabConstrictor itself rather than analyse data; they are listed apart in the App Centre. Absent means a normal app.
